name: Redirects for WP
author: Kamal Hosen

sections.description:
Redirects for WP is a fast, lightweight, and modern WordPress Redirect Plugin that helps you create and manage URL redirects without unnecessary bloat.

Whether you’re changing permalinks, migrating a website, fixing broken links, or improving SEO, Redirects for WP makes redirect management simple.

Perfect for:

  • SEO optimization
  • Website migration
  • Fixing broken URLs
  • Redirecting old pages
  • Changing permalink structures
  • WooCommerce URL redirects
  • Marketing campaign redirects
  • Domain migration
  • HTTP to HTTPS redirects

Unlike many heavy redirect plugins, Redirects for WP focuses on speed, simplicity, and native WordPress performance.

✨ Features

  • Create unlimited redirects
  • 301 Permanent Redirects
  • 302 Temporary Redirects
  • 307 Temporary Redirects
  • 308 Permanent Redirects
  • Simple redirect manager
  • Clean and modern interface
  • Fast redirect matching
  • Lightweight codebase
  • SEO-friendly redirects
  • Preserve search engine rankings
  • Fix broken links
  • Redirect old URLs
  • Redirect custom post types
  • Redirect pages
  • Redirect posts
  • Redirect WooCommerce products
  • Import-friendly architecture
  • Export-ready architecture
  • WordPress coding standards
  • No unnecessary bloat

🎯 Perfect For

  • WordPress SEO
  • Website migration
  • Domain migration
  • URL changes
  • Slug changes
  • Permalink updates
  • Broken link fixes
  • 404 error fixing
  • Marketing campaigns
  • Affiliate links
  • WooCommerce stores
  • Agencies
  • Freelancers
  • Developers

📈 Why Use Redirects?

Redirects help:

  • Preserve SEO rankings
  • Prevent 404 errors
  • Improve user experience
  • Maintain search engine indexing
  • Pass link equity
  • Handle URL changes safely
  • Improve website health

⚡ Supported Redirect Types

  • 301 Permanent Redirect
  • 302 Found Redirect
  • 307 Temporary Redirect
  • 308 Permanent Redirect

❤️ Lightweight

Redirects for WP is built with performance in mind.

No unnecessary modules.
No page builders.
No bloated framework.

Just fast WordPress redirects.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate Redirects for WP.
  3. Open Redirects from the WordPress Dashboard.
  4. Create your first redirect.
  5. Save and you’re done.
sections.faq:
Does it support 301 redirects?

Yes. You can create unlimited 301 redirects.

Does it support 302 redirects?

Yes.

Does it support 307 redirects?

Yes.

Does it support 308 redirects?

Yes.

Is it SEO friendly?

Absolutely. Redirects help preserve rankings and avoid broken URLs.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. You can redirect WooCommerce product URLs like any other WordPress URL.

Is it lightweight?

Yes. The plugin is designed to be fast and efficient.
